headline: Newgen Software announces a change in its registrar's corporate office address
hook: New RTA office address for Newgen Software
summary: Newgen Software Technologies Limited has notified the stock exchange about a change in the corporate office address of its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent. This administrative update ensures that physical shareholder correspondence and documentation are directed to the new location. For retail investors, this is standard compliance news with no impact on the company's financial performance or stock valuation.
why_it_matters: No impact on share price or company financials.

headline: Newgen Software reports September quarter net sales at Rs 422.24 crore
summary: Newgen Software reported consolidated net sales of Rs 422.24 crore for September 2026, marking a 5.35% increase year-on-year. Quarterly financial results provide insight into the software firm's operational performance and demand environment. Indian retail investors tracking mid-tier IT stocks can evaluate the revenue trajectory against sector expectations. The earnings release gives a direct reading on the company's baseline growth metrics for the quarter.
why_it_matters: Modest revenue growth for Newgen shareholders this quarter
